root_cause.text: The fsl-imx8mq-usb PHY driver’s probe function failed to store its `struct imx8mq_usb_phy *` in the platform device’s drvdata, so `remove()` later used uninitialized/missing platform driver data.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly says “Add missing platform_set_drvdata() as the data will be used in remove()”, and the patch adds `platform_set_drvdata(pdev, imx_phy);` in `imx8mq_usb_phy_probe()`, showing the bug was the missing drvdata initialization.

intent_record.intent_summary: Store the imx8mq USB PHY private data in the platform device during probe so later callbacks and cleanup paths can reliably access it.
intent_record.what: A call to platform_set_drvdata(pdev, imx_phy); was added in imx8mq_usb_phy_probe() immediately after successful allocation of the imx_phy structure and before subsequent resource initialization.
intent_record.how: This stores the newly allocated driver-private data in the platform device earlier in probe, making it available to later callbacks or error/unwind paths that retrieve driver data from the device and preventing missing private-data access during initialization.

grouping_result.intent: Store the imx8mq USB PHY private data in the platform device during probe so later callbacks and cleanup paths can reliably access it.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly fixes the root cause by saving the imx8mq USB PHY private struct in the platform device during probe, ensuring remove()/later callbacks can retrieve valid drvdata instead of missing or uninitialized data.
